verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated 'export everything and leave' feature in the evidence. Data can still be pulled out in pieces: the Microsoft Graph API lists user objects programmatically, diagnostic settings route activity logs to external endpoints for long-term retention, and the open SCIM standard provisions users and groups into other applications. Together these support a do-it-yourself export rather than a turnkey exit. Missing for 10: documented full-tenant export, explicit open-format guarantees for all data types (policies, apps, devices, credentials), migration/exit guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
